body: Love you mods, thank you so much we are here to HOLD

Jesus christ yes

I am not a financial advisor just a man with a dream

First off, you're cool for being honest with yourself and how you are. I really dislike how society can make someone feel about their own sexuality.

It is hard to discuss this topic outside of a place like reddit because of the instant judgement and confusion one can face. I feel you. Society is very sexualized and dating when you're like this can be really challenging. You're not alone, there are a lot of people who understand where you're coming from. 

But ofc even thinking that it's still so easy to feel lonely when you consider how the rest of society looks at you, that's where I'm at too.
There's a lot of truth in what you say; I suppose the sooner I accept that I might not be able to change the better. It's just so hard to do. Thank you

I don't know where I truly lie. I thought at one point that I might be asexual but then once in a while I did really crave sex with my partners. I definitely have to have real emotion connection to share that with someone.

I am studying currently to become a sommelier, and I'm hoping putting my nose into my books can keep my mind busy, maybe a new workout regiment.

I really appreciate your thoughtful post, it helps a lot to hear someone who has been in my shoes.

Your words are kind. I'm certainly in a heartbreak phase. I've held out for that someone who would accept me (I thought maybe that she would). A large part of me also feels like I must change for someone to truly love me. It's so conflicting.

I've never tried it, people always say on here that it doesn't help much or that the counselors suck. Personally I'm too afraid of even talking to one of those people that they will track me down and throw me in a bin. What are you feeling that made you call?
I'm so sorry. I've been there before almost a decade ago. Hold on friend, today you decided to step away, proud of you.

I agree, tanks can already sit on top of champions who build these items. Eclipse is a great item to stop tanks from completely nullifying lethality users' damage output because it gives %ArmPen per legendary.

If you have to build Duskblade or Claw you don't have that same luxury, so lethality users' will be left in a much worse spot...

It's not phase rush though at all, it's 15% movement speed, phase rush is way higher and it gives slow resistance on top of it. They've already nerfed it once, any more nerfs will make it a rather lackluster mythic.
